content: With Grand Theft Auto 6 finally launching, some fans are booking time off work, while others are making considerably bigger commitments to secure a few uninterrupted days in Vice City. According to reporting from Task & Purpose, 43 soldiers from the U.S. Army's 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion at Fort Stewart, Georgia, have signed up for a special reenlistment incentive offering a four-day weekend to play GTA 6 when it launched on Nov. 19.
